# OpenCode 2.0 fixture set

`opencode.sql` holds the tables the adapter reads, as OpenCode 2.0.21 creates them (its schema, not a user's data); `rows.sql` holds invented rows: the home is `/home/example`, and no id, path, prompt or reply comes from a real machine. The database is built from both at test time and never committed.

| Session               | What it exercises                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| --------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `ses_example01`       | Every message type (user, system, synthetic, assistant, compaction, agent-switched, model-switched, idle), an unknown type and unparseable `data`                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `ses_example02`       | A session migrated from 1.x whose `session_message` completion OpenCode 2 rewrote; the 1.x `message` row keeps the original                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `ses_example03`       | An assistant row with an error                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `ses_example04`       | A session started by `ses_example03` (`parent_id`)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `ses_example05`       | A session with no messages                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `ses_example06`       | An image-only prompt                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `ses_example07`       | A root session whose first prompt is a whole quoted string with a space (`opencode run`)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `ses_example08`       | A quoted prompt that is not the first                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `ses_example09`       | A session recorded by OpenCode 2.1.4, newer than the tested 2.0                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `ses_example10`       | Tool calls: every family row in its 1.x or 2.0 spelling, an unlisted plugin tool, a Code Mode `execute` call, a completed call, a shell call that exited non-zero, an error, a pending call, a `shell` call whose input is `{}`, completed and failed skill calls, an unknown part type, and a 1.x `task` call naming its child     |
| `ses_example11`       | The session the `task` call of `ses_example10` started                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `ses_example12`       | Stops and refusals: an aborted request with its `idle` row and a declined call inside it, a call rejected with a reason, a deny-rule and an `opencode run` refusal, a `tool.interrupted` call, a `Tool execution interrupted` call, and an aborted message with no completion time                                                  |
| `ses_example13`       | An aborted message migrated from 1.x                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `ses_example14`       | Exemplars of shapes the source writer writes that no session above shows: an assistant row with tokens and cost but no finish, `shell` with a command, `grep` with a path, a compaction with only its summary, a failed request with only its error, and an assistant row with no agent                                             |
| `ses_demo1` (written) | `scripts.ts`, `written-shop`: an agent, an image prompt, a reply with reasoning, tokens and cost, every intent of the writer's families, a plugin tool that failed, a skill, a spawn, a model switch, a declined call, an agent switch, a compaction, a failed request, a project command, a pending call, a stop and an idle event |
| `ses_demo2` (written) | The session the spawn of `ses_demo1` started                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `ses_demo3` (written) | `scripts.ts`, `written-billing`: a session `opencode run` started, recorded by 2.0.15, whose quoted first prompt holds quotes, and a global command                                                                                                                                                                                 |

Command files: `~/.config/opencode/commands/release.md` (global) and `/home/example/work/shop/.opencode/commands/review.md` (project).
